Means/variances follow algebraically; limiting exponentials and a uniform O(1/K) discarded-tail expectation prove distributional convergence, while variance follows by dominated series. Hypergeometric active count proves block recurrence. Independent finite exact-arithmetic and Monte Carlo checks passed; no numerical extrapolation substitutes for proof.
